VAR et = [EndTime]
VAR st = [StartTime]
RETURN
    IF ( et = st, st + TIME ( 0, 0, [Duration (ms)] / 1000 ), et )

VAR x = 'Progress Report End'[StartTime]
VAR y = 'Progress Report End'[End Time]
VAR z =
    DATEDIFF ( x, y, SECOND )
RETURN
    INT ( z / 60 ) & " mins "
        & MOD ( z, 60 ) & " sec"
